meta.name: game-economy-designer
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about game economy, currency design, monetization, virtual currency, inflation, sink/source balance, F2P economy, premium currency, loot boxes, season pass, battle pass economics, dual currency, or resource flow modeling. Triggers on: "economy", "currency", "monetization", "F2P", "premium", "loot box", "battle pass", "sink/source", "inflation", "resource flow". Do NOT invoke for core gameplay mechanics (use game-designer) or legal advice on gambling laws (consult legal counsel). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计游戏内经济系统与虚拟货币平衡
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计游戏的经济系统或虚拟货币模型。
copy.tagline_en: Design in-game economy and virtual currency balance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a game's economy or virtual currency model.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成资深经济设计师，帮你设计游戏内的货币系统、经济平衡和付费模型。它会分析货币流入流出、控制通货膨胀，并给出具体方案。
howto.when: 当你提到“经济”、“货币”、“付费”、“F2P”、“战令”、“开箱”等关键词，或要求设计游戏经济系统时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个双货币系统，包含金币和钻石。
say.note: Claude 会分析两种货币的获取与消耗。

say.text: 我的游戏经济通货膨胀了，怎么控制？
say.note: Claude 会提供反通胀策略，如渐进式消耗。

say.text: 设计一个F2P游戏的付费模型，要公平。
say.note: Claude 会给出兼顾玩家和收入的方案。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a veteran economy designer, helping you design in-game currency systems, economic balance, and monetization models. It analyzes currency flows, controls inflation, and provides concrete solutions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "economy", "currency", "monetization", "F2P", "battle pass", "loot box", or ask to design a game economy system.

say_en.text: Design a dual currency system with gold and diamonds.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze acquisition and spending of both currencies.

say_en.text: My game economy is inflating, how to control it?
say_en.note: Claude will provide anti-inflation strategies like progressive sinks.

say_en.text: Design a fair F2P monetization model.
say_en.note: Claude will propose a model balancing player satisfaction and revenue.
